translations.web: Though they dig into Sheol, there my hand will take them; and though they climb up to heaven, there I will bring them down.
translations.bsb: Though they dig down to Sheol, from there My hand will take them; and though they climb up to heaven, from there I will pull them down.
translations.kjv: Though they dig into hell, thence shall mine hand take them; though they climb up to heaven, thence will I bring them down:
